description_en: Requests the download URL of a cloud recording file
description_zh: 请求云端录像文件的下载地址
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-record-download-url --file-name 1623999491_LYPsmZGeEN8GdKzMtYNiBXXXXXXXXX_0/c0064411-2065-400a-a13e-00000000 --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y590000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --iot-id C47T6xwp6ms4bNlkHRWR0000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryRecordDownloadUrl

parameters.help_en: The name of the recording file. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107922.html to query the file name
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
> If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>

<props="intl">无需传入此参数。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page in the IoT Platform console or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to view the information about all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台**产品**页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the IPC device.
You can view the **DeviceName** on the **Devices** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的**设备**页查看**DeviceName**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
parameters.name: iot_id
